_comment: A real, runnable spec: it red-proofs redproof.py itself. Run it from this directory with `python redproof.py selfproof.spec.json`. Every case must report 'went red' — a case that stays green means the self-test no longer covers that guard. Use this file as the template for your own spec.

cases.label: unique-match gate (0 or 2+ matches must abort the case)
hollow detection (green after removal must be reported)
baseline-must-be-green gate
cases.from:
if code != 0:
        die(f"baseline is NOT green
cases.to:
if False:
        die(f"baseline is NOT green
